all.text: King Darien rules Kjeldor and seeks peace with Balduvia, urging that the rift between the two be healed like a wound, and noting that Kjeldor aided the Balduvians before and will again.
He frets that missing dead are turning up in Varchild's ranks and that she would rather have the maps of the new Kjeldor drawn in Balduvian blood, even as he calls every able sword to Kjeldor's side.
When Jodah and Jaya warn Kjeld, the Knights of Stromgald's coup fails and Darien is convinced.

csp.text: King Darien faces the Knights of Stromgald, who strike Darien's Roost from two sides, but his tacticians prevent a pincer attack on Kjeldor.
He joins the fight on the last day of the Battle of Kjeldor and defeats Haakon, ending the battle.
With his dream of unification fulfilled, Darien becomes the last king of Kjeldor.
